scientific_limitations: Complete classification applies to strict pure Nash equilibria/fixed points under defection-at-tie; weak equilibria at thresholds are not classified.
Two equally sized, uniformly mixed communities; homogeneous positive parameters, zero prejudice, zero self-influence.
No dynamic convergence or empirical effectiveness claim.
Equivalence with unpublished or unindexed work remains possible.
title: Sharp segregation threshold in a two-community opinion–public-goods game
